## The subagent header gives its rows back to the transcript

- **Context, Model and Thinking now share a single row.** The inspector was printing each as a label row plus a value row, so three short values — a context size, a model name, an effort level — occupied five rows above the transcript. On the wide inspector they read across instead:

  ```
  Context 33K / 400K · 8% used  Model opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-extended  Thinking: medium
  ```

- **The model name is no longer cut short.** The stacked form clipped every value to 32 characters, so `opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-extended` became `opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-exte…` while ~80 columns of the row sat empty. The inline form uses the full width, with a per-field cap so one long value cannot push the others off the row.
- **Missing values take no space.** A child with no window data used to print `Context` / `— / —` / `Model` / `—` / `Thinking: —`. Those fields are now omitted, so the header collapses straight to the transcript — three more rows of the child's actual work.
- Together that is **five rows of chrome replaced by one**, on the screen where you were looking for the child's reasoning.

- The sidebar is deliberately unchanged. Its column is narrow enough that stacking is the right shape there, so the shared row component now has two layouts and the sidebar keeps the one it had, pixel for pixel.

## Validation

- PiTTy typecheck passed; complete local suite: **469 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed**; type-escape scan clean. The new test asserts the full model string, so it fails against the previous 32-character clip, and every sidebar frame assertion passes untouched.
